name: Open Discussion
overview: Scripture encourages believers to engage thoughtfully and lovingly with the world around them, as demonstrated by Paul’s stirred spirit upon witnessing idolatry in Athens. True wisdom is characterized by purity, peace, gentleness, and mercy, fostering open and respectful dialogue without partiality or hypocrisy. This approach aligns with presenting ourselves as living sacrifices, offering our whole selves in service to God, which includes how we communicate and discuss matters of faith.
